comment: * Interface declaring unsolicited radio indications for modem APIs.

methods.name: public void hardwareConfigChanged(int indicationType, android.hardware.radio.modem.HardwareConfig[] configs)
methods.comment:
* Indicates when the hardware configuration associated with the RILd changes.
     * @param indicationType Type of radio indication
     * @param configs Array of hardware configs

methods.name: public void modemReset(int indicationType, String reason)
methods.comment:
* Indicates when there is a modem reset.
     * @param indicationType Type of radio indication
     * @param reason The reason for the reset. It may be a crash signature if the restart was due to
     *        a crash or some string such as "user-initiated restart" or "AT command initiated
     *        restart" that explains the cause of the modem restart

methods.name: public void radioCapabilityIndication(int indicationType, android.hardware.radio.modem.RadioCapability radioCapability)
methods.comment:
* Sent when setRadioCapability() completes. Returns the same RadioCapability as
     * getRadioCapability() and is the same as the one sent by setRadioCapability().
     * @param indicationType Type of radio indication
     * @param radioCapability Current radio capability

methods.name: public void radioStateChanged(int indicationType, int radioState)
methods.comment:
* Indicates when radio state changes.
     * @param indicationType Type of radio indication
     * @param radioState Current radio state

methods.name: public void rilConnected(int indicationType)
methods.comment:
* Indicates the ril connects and returns the version.
     * @param indicationType Type of radio indication

methods.name: public void onImeiMappingChanged(int indicationType, ImeiInfo imeiInfo)
methods.comment:
* Indicates when there is a change in the IMEI with respect to the sim slot.
     *
     * @param imeiInfo IMEI information
